verdict.rationale: Netlify's own docs claim "Automatic HTTPS", and a community user reports free custom domains with SSL, so automatic TLS provisioning on custom domains is supported in some form. Nothing in the evidence documents automatic renewal, wildcard certificates, or coverage of every domain. missing for 10: wildcard certificate support, documented automatic renewal, first-party confirmation that certificates are free, coverage of all domains, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can get free, automatically renewing TLS certificates for every domain including wildcards

citations.quote: Free, good support, custom domains with SSL
